review.images: Reviewed the official ARLO wide hero and five gallery assets. Kept the wide waterfront image for gallery and card, omitted the alternate crop of that same scene, and retained the separate promenade, apartment living and bedroom and shared lobby.
review.location: Developer’s own regional map, reference point and brochure physical page 4 reviewed. Read all three estimates visually, including the 10-minute DXB figure. Kardosh Realty’s published pin differs, so the developer point is labeled a district reference and no exact entrance is claimed.
review.floorPlans: Official 20-page PDF verified against fresh bytes. Reviewed the cover, all 18 complete apartment drawings and the three-level townhouse sheet. All printed square-foot totals agree with their components. The shared townhouse drawing preserves both physical-area tables.

unavailable: Exact entrance, current walking routes and operating status of future transit services require confirmation.
